business_problem: Rosebud AI wanted to let people create, refine, and publish playable 2D and 3D games without coding expertise, while supporting real-time interactions, variable traffic, and affordable generation of code and creative assets.
solution_summary: Rosebud AI consolidated its infrastructure on Google Cloud and uses Gemini models to turn natural-language game ideas into playable projects. A conversational agent guides users through a questionnaire, then a one-shot generator creates an initial game; Gemini 3 Flash is the primary generation model, while Gemini embeddings support 3D-asset retrieval and reranking. Cloud Run scales compute for traffic spikes, Cloud Tasks moves long-running builds off the browser request path, and Cloud Storage and Cloud SQL preserve project state so users can return to their work. Vision AI moderates images against Rosebud's content standards. The platform supports interactive browser games, but the source does not disclose a detailed data-ingestion or model-serving topology.

Gemini embeddings retrieve and rerank existing 3D assets. Cloud Tasks offloads long builds, Cloud Run scales the service, Cloud Storage and Cloud SQL retain project state, and Vision AI moderates images.
